pin_policy: Pin the upstream commits matching the RELEASED build players run, not the tip of `upcoming`. Elite Redux cuts releases from `upcoming` with no tag or release branch. ABILITIES_COUNT == 1034 is a necessary but NOT sufficient check -- it holds across a month of unreleased commits (2026-03-27 through 2026-04-24). These SHAs were fixed by direct observation of a real v2.65.3b ROM: it shows Feathercoat at 10%/20% (changed upstream 2026-04-20), Scarecrow as "Scare + Bad Luck" (changed 2026-04-21), and the ability "Menacing Situation" (renamed to "Phobia" 2026-04-06), so the ROM predates 2026-04-06; and the v2.65.3b changelog names the Munchlax Redux adoption-center entry, whose commit is 2026-03-27T01:49Z, setting the lower bound. eliteredux.net states v2.65.3b was last updated 2026-03-26. tests/test_oracle.py asserts ABILITIES_COUNT against ER-nextdex's published (released-game) data -- keep that green when repinning, but do not rely on it alone to pick a SHA.
